targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS time, composite_score, dataset FROM monitoring.semantic_scores ORDER BY created_at
SELECT tier, COUNT(*) as count FROM monitoring.semantic_scores GROUP BY tier

SELECT run_id, dataset, round(if_score::numeric,3) as if_score, round(ks_psi_score::numeric,3) as ks_psi, round(adwin_score::numeric,3) as adwin, round(composite_score::numeric,3) as composite, tier FROM monitoring.semantic_scores ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT created_at AS time, structural_score, dataset FROM monitoring.structural_scores ORDER BY created_at
SELECT dataset, SUM(null_violations) as total_null_violations FROM monitoring.structural_scores GROUP BY dataset
